name: normalizedStandardWithNullTypeUsesStandard
expected: Returns a Period normalized to 1 hour 30 minutes using standard PeriodType because null means standard type as per Javadoc.

name: normalizedStandardOverflowsSecondsToMinutes
expected: Returns a Period with 1 minute 30 seconds, converting excess seconds into minutes.

name: normalizedStandardOverflowsMonthsFromYearsAndMonths
expected: Returns a Period with 2 years 3 months, because 15 months overflows into 1 year and 3 months, combining with the existing 1 year.

name: normalizedStandardMonthAndDaysDoNotOverflow
expected: Returns a Period with 1 month 40 days, because days will not overflow into the months field as specified in Javadoc.

name: normalizedStandardMissingYearsAndMonthsThrowsException
input: Period with 12 months 0 days, PeriodType.yearMonthDayTime() with years/months unsupported? Let's assume a type missing years/months while period has non-zero years/months
expected: Throws UnsupportedOperationException because the period contains non-zero years or months but the specified period type does not support them.

name: normalizedStandardWithZeroValues
expected: Returns a zero Period with all fields set to zero.

name: normalizedStandardNegativeMillisAndSeconds
expected: Returns a Period with negative values normalized correctly (-1 minute -30 seconds).

name: normalizedStandardWeeksToDaysConversion
expected: Returns a Period with 14 days, converting weeks to days via standard 7-day week assumption.

name: normalizedStandardArithmeticExceptionOnOverflow
expected: Throws ArithmeticException if any field or resulting duration is too large to be represented as an int/long safely.

name: normalizedStandardWithCustomPeriodTypeOmittingWeeks
expected: Returns a Period where weeks are omitted and correctly represented in days or standard fields according to the provided PeriodType.
